summary: Sample flux and explicitly requested pressure, density or electron-temperature profiles on the same R-Z grid with explicit units; distinguish raw psi samples from single-turn linked flux.

identity.relation: equilibrium field and explicit observation conventions to physical-quantity samples at requested points
identity.direction: equilibrium, R, Z, observations -> flux_loops / thomson and units
identity.definition: Use the existing bilinear sampler. For flux_loops.quantity=raw_psi, retain equilibrium.psi_unit; for quantity=magnetic_flux, output Wb and multiply by 2*pi only when psi is explicitly declared in Wb/rad; Wb inputs are unchanged. thomson samples only the actually requested profiles whose units are declared consistently, and does not infer missing channels. Every result carries units.
identity.model: read-only point sampling of an equilibrium field; thomson is a legacy namespace, not a Thomson-scattering instrument model
identity.geometry: rectangular R-Z grid in cylindrical coordinates
identity.coordinates: fields are indexed [Z,R], observation points are [R,Z] per row, and coordinate units are m
identity.boundary: bilinear sampling inside the closed grid boundary with no extrapolation. Empty or unknown requests, empty point sets, missing fields and unit conflicts are rejected; coil turns, reference-loop subtraction and instrument response are not implied.
assumptions: Input fields come from the same physical state and the same grid.
The caller explicitly declares the psi unit and gauge; the validated convention is psi=R A_phi with unit Wb/rad.
Pressure is in Pa and density in m^-3; electron temperature explicitly uses K, eV or J and must match profile_units exactly; no conversion is performed here.

inputs.name: equilibrium
inputs.description: Equilibrium state to sample; flux uses psi and psi_unit, profiles use profiles and profile_units.
inputs.units: physical units declared by the individual fields
inputs.constraints: Only requested fields are accessed; every field is finite and has the same grid shape.

inputs.name: R
inputs.constraints: Finite rectangular grid with strictly increasing radial coordinate and at least two columns.

inputs.name: Z
inputs.constraints: Finite, same shape as R, with strictly increasing axial coordinate and at least two rows.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.description: A flux request contains points, quantity and unit; a profile request under thomson contains points and per-channel {unit}, and may also contain values/sigma used by inversion.
inputs.units: points in m; each channel unit is explicitly declared
inputs.constraints: Only flux_loops and thomson are allowed; flux quantity must be raw_psi or magnetic_flux; profile keys are limited to density, electron_temperature, p_parallel and p_perp. Every request must actually have a value; unknown kind/channel/flux fields are not ignored.

outputs.name: flux_loops
outputs.description: Return raw psi samples or single-turn linked flux in point order.
outputs.constraints: Present only when requested; raw_psi is not multiplied by 2*pi and a flux conversion must not produce a nonfinite value.

outputs.name: thomson
outputs.description: Return profile samples for explicitly requested channels; temperature or density is not inferred from pressure.
outputs.units: pressure in Pa; density in m^-3; electron temperature as declared
outputs.constraints: Only requested channels are returned; a missing requested field fails.

outputs.name: units
outputs.description: Unit metadata in one-to-one correspondence with the actual outputs.
outputs.constraints: The residual reducer uses this metadata to match explicit observation units.

preconditions: Source fields, grid, observation points and units are explicit and mutually consistent.
supported: Explicit distinction between raw psi samples and Wb single-turn linked flux.
Point sampling of supplied pressure, density and electron temperature.
excluded: Thomson spectral response, calibration, spatial convolution, temperature inversion or an electron distribution that was not supplied.
Automatic inference of flux gauge, turns, reference-loop subtraction or 2*pi conversion of all raw psi.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for missing fields, empty/unknown requests, invalid point sets, unit mismatches or out-of-domain points.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Sampler exceptions propagate; a nonfinite flux conversion raises FloatingPointError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: This function does not solve an equilibrium; an inversion trial must verify forward convergence before entering it.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partially successful result is returned on error; the caller's equilibrium is not modified.

example.description: A uniform axial field Bz=2 T has psi=R^2 Wb/rad; the single-turn flux at R=1 m should be 2*pi Wb.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.diagnostics import synthesize_equilibrium_diagnostics
R,Z=np.meshgrid([0.,1.,2.],[-1.,0.,1.])
r=synthesize_equilibrium_diagnostics(R=R,Z=Z,equilibrium={'psi':R**2,'psi_unit':'Wb/rad'},observations={'flux_loops':{'points':[[1.,0.]],'quantity':'magnetic_flux','unit':'Wb'}})
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['flux_loops'],[2*np.pi],rtol=1e-14)
assert r['units']['flux_loops']=='Wb'
example.expected: Returns [2*pi] Wb, consistent with the independent analytic circular-area times Bz; a raw_psi request returns [1] Wb/rad.

scope: Analytic psi-to-full-flux relation for a uniform Bz.
Interior/boundary sampling of a linear manufactured profile, units and non-modification.
Rejection of missing channels/unknown requests/unsupported turns and reference-loop fields; real Picard inversion consumer.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Author regressions, independent analytic and independent discrete-reference comparisons, and selected installed-wheel user calls completed in the exact environment; they cover only the listed contract and examples. Root-level independent intake, human scientific recognition, redistribution permission and public release are separate decisions; they do not extend this to arbitrary closures, devices or global identifiability proofs.
known_limitations: Bilinear interpolation has discrete interpolation error; values at node locations can be verified analytically.
Unit labels cannot prove that the caller's actual data are correctly scaled.

nodes.description: Validate all observation kinds, units and source fields; form per-channel sampling requests and explicit conversion conventions.
Call the same bilinear operator for each explicitly requested field; fail if a request is not satisfied.
Apply the 2*pi conversion only to explicitly Wb/rad->Wb flux, and assemble samples and units from the original fields.

edges.description: Obtain the field for each request.
edges.transform: Project item by item; do not invent a missing profile.

edges.description: Obtain the coordinates for each request.
Provide explicit units and flux convention.

execution.ordering: Validate requests and units first, then run bilinear sampling for flux_loops and each requested profile, and finally convert and assemble.
branches: Multiply by 2*pi when quantity=magnetic_flux and psi_unit=Wb/rad; do not apply this conversion to raw_psi or a Wb source.
execution.state_ownership: Read the caller's fields without modifying arrays; output samples are owned by this call.
execution.failure_propagation: Any request error or conversion overflow terminates the whole call; no success with dropped channels is returned.
